verdict.rationale: Sill streams either a single Mac window or the whole desktop. Its bar shows window thumbnails one tap away, and an Apps list shows open and installed apps, so switching between windows and apps mid-session is documented. Nothing in the evidence covers picking a specific monitor on a multi-display Mac or switching between displays. missing for 10: per-monitor selection and switching on multi-display hosts, independent hands-on corroboration of mid-session switching.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
Sill's Apps list on an iPad held sideways, with a search field, the apps open now and every app installed on the Mac.
